verses.text: Come close and hear this, you nations! Listen, all you peoples! Let the earth and everything in it hear, the whole world and everything it brings forth.
The LORD is furious with every nation and angry with every army. He has marked them for total destruction and handed them over to be slaughtered.
The dead will be thrown out. The smell of their bodies will rise, and the mountains will melt in their blood.
The whole army of the sky will dissolve. The sky will roll up like a scroll, and all its armies will fall away like leaves dropping off a vine or a fig tree.
“My sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Look, it's coming down on Edom, on the people under my curse, to bring judgment.”
The LORD's sword is soaked with blood and covered in fat, the blood of lambs and goats, the fat from rams' kidneys. The LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
The wild oxen will fall with them, young bulls along with the strongest bulls. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their dust slick with fat.
The LORD has set a day to take vengeance, a year to settle accounts for Zion.
Edom's streams will turn into pitch and its dust into sulfur. The whole land will be burning pitch.
It won't go out day or night. Its smoke will rise forever. It'll lie in ruins generation after generation, and nobody will ever pass through it.
Pelicans and porcupines will take over. Owls and ravens will live there. He'll stretch the measuring line of chaos across it and drop the plumb line of emptiness.
They'll call for nobles to take charge of the kingdom, but none will be there. All its rulers will come to nothing.
Thorns will sprout in the palaces, nettles and thistles in the fortresses. Jackals will make their home there, and ostriches will roam its courtyards.
Desert animals will meet wolves there, and wild goats will call to each other. Even the night creature will settle there and find a place to rest.
The arrow snake will nest there, lay and hatch her eggs, and gather her young in her shade. The kites will gather there too, each with its mate.
Look it up in the LORD's book and read it. None of these creatures will be missing, and none will be without its mate. His mouth gave the command, and his Spirit gathered them.
He drew the lot for them and measured out their land with his own hand. They'll own it forever and live there generation after generation.
